d:
Panjab men 2027 ke vidhanasbha chunav se pahle nashe ka mudda ek bar phir rajnitik bahas ke kendr men hai. lagatar sarkaron ke vadon ke bavjud nashe ki samasya bani huee hai. aise men saval hai ki kya yah mudda aagami chunav men matdataon ke rukh aur voton ke samikran ko prabhavit karega?
Thank you for watching our video!
